title: 千珏·双生小野餐
description: 白色羊灵与黑色狼灵在小野餐垫旁安静相伴，面具和两种轮廓鲜明，长弓静放。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kindred is a recognizable pair: a slender white-furred Lamb with a dark ornate mask and pale woolly silhouette, accompanied by a flowing black Wolf spirit with a pale mask-like face. Keep Lamb's modest fully covering purple-gray tunic and opaque leggings, with hooves visible. Her curved bow lies flat and inactive, while Wolf forms one soft friendly floating ribbon shape, never baring frightening teeth.
art_direction.scene: Lamb sits on a small picnic cloth and places a berry beside a little cup while Wolf curves gently around the far side like a companion peeking at the snack. Their masks face each other with quiet interest. One rounded tree and a patch of tiny flowers make a bright clearing, without hunting, prey, arrows, or ominous shadows.
art_direction.palette: wool ivory, charcoal purple, lavender, berry pink
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
